intelligence.essence: Do not create a new board. Go grab the intelligent board from the Hub — the exact code, already raised and elevated, looking as it should — and put it in the frame. Use part of it, not the whole thing. Beside the player for now; when the player's not there, the whole thing is the intelligent board.
intelligence.simple_view: We already have a beautiful board that glows and lifts off the page. We take that same board and put it in the frame, next to the player. One big board holds the words, and inside it sit two smaller boards — three sometimes — so the words are easy to read.
intelligence.grandma_view: Think of a beautiful tray that holds smaller shining dishes. The big board is the tray; the little boards hold the words, two or three at a time, so your eyes rest on one small piece, then the next. When there is no player on the slide, the whole tray is the board, glowing on its own.
